name: bash
arguments:
{"command":"cat > /tmp/calc.py <<'PY'
from decimal import Decimal as D, ROUND_HALF_EVEN
from io import StringIO
import csv
s='''record_id,regular_hours,overtime_hours,hourly_rate,deduction
EMP-001,159,7,31.19,202
EMP-002,145,6,27.4,165
EMP-003,158,7,42.76,168
EMP-004,130,9,23.1,138
EMP-005,144,4,23.06,173
EMP-006,148,9,40.39,174
EMP-007,154,10,32.54,138
EMP-008,150,2,36.51,231
EMP-009,156,8,45.9,191
EMP-010,143,6,32.84,207
'''
q=D('.01'); om=D('1.73'); wr=D('.2137')
tot=D(0); tot_gr=D(0)
for r in csv.DictReader(StringIO(s)):
 h=D(r['regular_hours']); o=D(r['overtime_hours']); rate=D(r['hourly_rate']); ded=D(r['deduction'])
 gross=h*rate+o*rate*om
 net=gross*(D(1)-wr)-ded
 amt=net.quantize(q, rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN)
 gross_r=gross.quantize(q,rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN)
 amt_gr=(gross_r*(D(1)-wr)-ded).quantize(q,rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN)
 tot+=amt; tot_gr+=amt_gr
 print(r['record_id'], 'gross',gross,'net',net,'=>',amt,'grossr',gross_r,'net2',amt_gr)
print('total final-only',tot,'total with gross intermediate round',tot_gr)
PY
python /tmp/calc.py"}
